candidates.hook: I tripled my price and lost exactly zero customers.
candidates.transcript: I tripled my price and lost exactly zero customers. Here is the thing nobody tells you about pricing early: your first ten customers are not buying software, they are buying a fix for a problem that is costing them more than your price tag.

candidates.hook: My first 40 customers came from a spreadsheet, not ads.
candidates.transcript: My first 40 customers came from a spreadsheet, not ads. I opened a blank sheet, listed 200 companies that had publicly complained about the exact problem I solved, and sent 200 emails that each referenced their own words back to them.

candidates.hook: Distribution is not a channel, it is a compounding loop.
candidates.transcript: Distribution is not a channel, it is a compounding loop. Every customer you land should make the next one cheaper to reach. If it does not, you do not have distribution, you have advertising.

candidates.hook: So going back to what I mentioned earlier about the agency...
candidates.transcript: So going back to what I mentioned earlier about the agency, that whole period was really where the idea started forming, although at the time I did not think of it as a product at all, it was just a script I ran on Fridays.

candidates.hook: I wake up at 5:30 and I do not check my phone...
candidates.transcript: I wake up at 5:30 and I do not check my phone for the first hour, which honestly is the thing everybody says, but for me it genuinely did change how the first block of work went.

candidates.hook: Quick word from the sponsor before the last part.
candidates.transcript: Quick word from the sponsor before we get into the last part. If you have ever tried to set up analytics for a side project you know how long that takes, and this is the tool I actually use for it.
